hypotheses.Q0_native_tensor_is_exact: Native reconstruction reaches at least 0.9999 effect fidelity everywhere.
hypotheses.Q1_same_cell_codewords_are_functionally_: A different valid codeword with the same relation and answer reaches at least 0.95 target-effect fidelity everywhere.
hypotheses.Q2_answer_equivalence_crosses_relations: A valid codeword with the same answer and next relation reaches at least 0.90 target-effect fidelity everywhere.
hypotheses.Q3_wrong_answer_codeword_routes_its_dono: A next-answer codeword from the same relation makes the donor answer win at least 80% of selected held-out-template examples in every run.
hypotheses.Q4_answer_routing_crosses_relations: A next-answer codeword from the next relation makes the donor answer win at least 80% of selected held-out-template examples in every run.
hypotheses.Q5_wrong_answer_codeword_overrides_targe: The original target answer survives a same-relation next-answer codeword on at most 30% of selected held-out-template examples in every run.
hypotheses.Q6_relation_is_not_a_required_final_cont: Changing donor relation changes next-answer routing accuracy by at most 0.10 everywhere.
hypotheses.Q7_rule_and_arbitrary_codewords_share_th: Selected and unselected same-answer cross-relation fidelity differs by at most 0.10 in every run.
hypotheses.Q8_template_transfer_is_stable: Selected same-answer cross-relation fidelity differs by at most 0.10 across templates in every run.
hypotheses.Q9_signal_gate_passes: Every scored cell contains at least 64 effectful examples.
